definitions.exponent: contraction exponent per pass (n iterations) of a SQUARED error, in nats: r means a decay like exp(-r t/n). Negative: growth.
definitions.c: gamma n lambda, the step in units of the model (vrlab.order_model): lambda an eigenvalue of the common Hessian in the model; on logistic regression c_min and c_max use lambda_min and lambda_max of F''(eta_*).
definitions.gammaR2: step size gamma times R^2 = prob.R2, the largest smoothness constant of the f_i (logistic regression: max_i (||x_i||^2/4 + lambda); instance (S): mu + c lambda_max(A_m), just below the nominal mu kappa); the textbook step is 1/4.
definitions.model.iid_expectation: exponent of E e_t^2 for i.i.d. indices: -n log(spectral radius) of the exact 4x4 moment recursion (order_model.iid_exponent); its limit n -> infinity is min(2c, 1).
definitions.model.typical: median over 9 seeds of the exponent of ONE simulated run (order_model.simulate_passes, 150 passes): minus the least-squares slope of the pass-end values of log max(e^2, max_j psi_j^2) (squared size of the state) over the passes 30..150; 'e2' is the same fit on log e^2. min and max are over the seeds.
definitions.model.rr_limit: order_model.rr_exponent(c): -2 log(spectral radius) of the fluid pass matrix (R3).
definitions.model.rr_first_moment: the same with the exact first-moment pass matrix at finite n (an upper bound on the exponent of E e^2).
definitions.model.cyclic_limit: order_model.cyclic_exponent_limit(c): -2 Re of the rightmost root of the limiting characteristic function (R2); negative beyond c_*.
definitions.model.cyclic_companion: order_model.cyclic_exponent(n, c): companion matrix of the recurrence at finite n.
definitions.model.cyclic_simulated: exponent of the (deterministic) simulated cyclic run, same window as model.typical.
definitions.model.cyclic_threshold: c at which the companion radius at finite n equals 1 (brentq, xtol 1e-4).
definitions.logistic.status: converged: ||theta_t - eta_*||^2 <= 1e-10 ||theta_0 - eta_*||^2 at some record within 300 passes; diverged: the error exceeded 1e+12 times its initial value (the run is then frozen: 'exploded') or ended above its initial value ('ended_above'); stalled: neither. A stalled run is 'growing' when its fitted exponent is negative (the error increases over the second half of the run) and slow otherwise (it still converges, too slowly for the budget). status_counts gives the three statuses and, under 'detail', the numbers of exploded, ended_above, stalled_growing and stalled_slow runs.
definitions.logistic.exponent: minus the least-squares slope of log ||theta_t - eta_*||^2 against the pass number over the pass-end records p with p_end/2 <= p <= p_end, p_end being the last pass that ends before the first record below the floor 1e-18 (the second-half window of B2); needs at least 4 records; not defined for diverged runs.
definitions.logistic.passes: passes (iterations / n, the initial full gradient not counted) to the first record with relative squared distance <= 1e-10, log-linear interpolation between records (algorithms.grads_to_accuracy); records every n/10 iterations. This is a FIRST passage: under reshuffling the error is not monotone within a pass (it dips after each pass boundary).
definitions.logistic.passes_stay: passes from which the relative squared distance stays <= 1e-10 until the end of the run (log-linear interpolation after the last record above the target); equal to 'passes' for a monotone run.
definitions.logistic.gain: passes_iid_fastest, passes_rr_fastest: median first-passage passes at the step of the grid that minimises them, per order; passes_iid_stay, passes_rr_stay: median passes_stay at the step that minimises it; saving_first = 1 - rr/iid on the first, saving_stay on the second; rr_best_over_iid_best_exponent: ratio of the median exponents at the best steps.
definitions.logistic.best: for one order: the step of the grid with the largest median exponent among the steps at which every run converged ('fastest': the smallest median number of passes).
definitions.logistic.law_R3: order_model.rr_exponent(c_min) with c_min = gamma n lambda_min(F''(eta_*)); rel_err = measured median reshuffled exponent / law - 1, at the steps where every reshuffled run converged.
definitions.logistic.fixed_order_failure: a shuffled-once or cyclic run FAILS at a step if it diverged, or if it did not reach 1e-10 within the 300 passes of the budget AND its exponent is below half the median exponent of the i.i.d. runs at the same step (so the count depends on the budget). SLOW (fixed_orders.*.n_slow_or_failing) is the wider notion: failing, or converged with an exponent below half the i.i.d. median. Steps at which an i.i.d. run diverged are left out. For each notion: number of (problem, step) pairs concerned, smallest c_max = gamma n lambda_max(F''(eta_*)) with one, largest c_max without, and how many lie below c_* of the model.
definitions.logistic.law_R2: min of order_model.cyclic_exponent_limit at c_min and at c_max (the limiting fixed-order exponent of the model increases up to c = 2.148 and decreases beyond: over the spectrum of F''(eta_*) it is smallest at one of the two ends); compared with the measured exponents by difference, in nats per pass, because it vanishes at c_*.
definitions.logistic.check: largest relative difference, over the records of the first 30 passes at which the squared error is above the floor 1e-18, between the batched loop of this script and vrlab.algorithms.saga (seed 0, textbook step, the four orders).
definitions.hard.count: gradient evaluations (n for the initial full gradient, then 1 per iteration), in units of n, at which the mean over the seeds of ||theta_t - eta_*||^2 / ||eta_*||^2 FIRST falls below eps (records every 8 iterations, log-linear interpolation); null if not reached in the budget. Under reshuffling the seed mean is a sawtooth within each pass (a dip shortly after each pass boundary), so three counts are given: 'count' (first passage), 'stay_count' (count from which the mean stays <= eps until the end of the run) and 'pass_end_count' (first pass END, i.e. count n (p + 1), at which the mean is <= eps, the convention of the floors of Proposition B4-floors). 'boot' is the 2.5%, 50%, 97.5% quantiles of 'count' over 500 bootstrap resamples of the seeds (seed variability of the count of the mean; it does not estimate the distance to an expectation carried by rare runs).
definitions.hard.below_iid_floor_from: for the reshuffled order at its best step: smallest count from which the seed mean is below the floor of inequality (expected-sweep) of the A1 note at the SAME count, at every later record at which that floor exceeds 1e-25 (comparison at equal counts, free of the choice of eps; below 1e-25 the runs meet the rounding floor of double precision); below_iid_floor_until is the last count of that range; smallest_mean_over_floor the smallest ratio mean / floor over it; null if the mean is above the floor at the last record of the range.
definitions.hard.typical_count: median over the seeds of the same count for single runs.
definitions.hard.bound_iid: bounds.lower_bound_iid_span(..., initial_full_gradient=True) / n: Corollary cor:sweep of the A1 note, total count of any span method with i.i.d. queries after one full gradient, for the EXPECTED error; null when the dimension condition q^(2m) <= eps fails.
definitions.hard.bound_any: bounds.lower_bound_any_sequence(...) / n: Proposition prop:anyseq, any index sequence, pathwise.
definitions.hard.best: step of the grid with the smallest first-passage count (per order and per eps); its stay_count, pass_end_count and boot are those of that step; 'best_stay' is the step with the smallest stay_count.
definitions.hard.worst_seed_share: largest single-seed error divided by the sum over the seeds, at the first record at which the seed mean is <= eps (1/S for identical runs).
definitions.model.rr_mean_square: order_model.rr_ms_exponent(n, c): exact exponent of E e^2 for the reshuffled order at finite n, -log(spectral radius) of the exact 4x4 second-moment pass matrix.
definitions.model.rr_over_iid_typical: rr_simulated.median / iid_typical.median at the same n and c.
definitions.model.c_star, omega_star: order_model.cyclic_critical(): critical step of a fixed order in the limit n -> infinity and the frequency of the root on the imaginary axis.
definitions.model.cyclic_best: order_model.cyclic_best(): c and value of the largest limiting fixed-order exponent.
definitions.model.n=<n>: rr_max_abs_dev_from_limit: largest |rr_simulated.median - rr_limit| over the values of c; rr_max_abs_dev_from_mean_square: the same against rr_mean_square (exact at that n); rr_max_seed_spread, iid_max_seed_spread: largest (max - min over the seeds) of the simulated exponents over the values of c.
definitions.model.expectation_vs_runs: at the passes listed: exact_E_e2 (4x4 recursion), median, max and mean over the seeds of e^2 of single i.i.d. runs; all_slots_refreshed_pass: pass at which the last slot of the initial memory is refreshed (median, min, max over the seeds); slow_amplitude_times_n: n * order_model.iid_slow_amplitude; plateau_limit: order_model.iid_plateau = 2 c^3 / (2c - 1)^2.
definitions.logistic.at_grid_edge: true when the selected step is the smallest or the largest of the grid.
definitions.logistic.law_R3.<group>: over the (problem, step) pairs of the group at which every reshuffled run converged: n_pairs, max_abs_rel_err with the pair where it occurs (worst), median_rel_err, n_within_10pct.
definitions.logistic.fixed_orders.law_R2: differences measured - law over the pairs with a measured exponent: numbers of pairs, largest and median absolute difference, median difference, per order.
definitions.hard.count_over_bound: count_over_bound_iid, count_over_bound_any: count / bound; the same with stay_ and pass_end_ prefixes; rr_best_over_iid_best: ratio of the first-passage counts of the two orders at their best steps.
definitions.hard.min_block: bounds.hard_instance_min_block: smallest block length m with q^(2m) <= eps (dimension condition).
definitions.hard.min_ratio_to_any_sequence_floor: smallest ratio, over the records, of the seed mean to the pathwise floor of Proposition prop:anyseq (must be >= 1).
definitions.hard.caveat: at the count where the i.i.d. seed mean reaches eps: expectation_floor is the exact expectation of the pathwise tail bound (1/n) sum_j (q^(2 min(1 + tau_j, m)) - q^(2m)) / (1 - q^(2m)), tau_j the number of queries to component j (Lemma lem:support (ii) and Proposition prop:tail of the A1 note), a certified lower bound on the EXPECTED relative error; pathwise_floor_seed_mean is the mean of the same bound over the index streams of the seeds actually run; worst_seed_share: see hard.worst_seed_share; expected_unsampled is the expected number of (seed, component) pairs never queried, S n (1 - 1/n)^t; realized_unsampled their number in the streams actually run. (The seed mean at that count is eps by construction.)
